owners.name: NBCUniversal
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sportsbook advertising in legal states; league windows cap sportsbook spots per game (NFL ~one per break structure); responsible-gambling copy expected. Peacock carries betting-adjacent integrations.
owners.fanduel_notes: Major live-sports reach vehicle; SNF + NBA package makes it a core sportsbook TV partner.

owners.name: Disney / ESPN
owners.stance_notes: ESPN carries sportsbook advertising; its former PENN sportsbook partnership has ended. ABC/Disney entertainment inventory is more conservative; no gambling around kids content.
owners.fanduel_notes: Verify current category rules and any replacement betting partnerships before buying. Buy live sport selectively and retain a conflict check.

owners.name: FOX Corp
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sportsbook ads in legal states. FOX holds a long-dated option to acquire a stake in FanDuel parent structures (from the FOX Bet era) — commercially entangled with the category.
owners.fanduel_notes: Historically close to Flutter/FanDuel via FOX Bet legacy; big NFL/college reach. Tubi = free-streaming reach with sports events.

owners.name: Paramount / CBS
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sportsbook in legal states within league rules; March Madness inventory subject to NCAA sensitivities around college audiences.
owners.fanduel_notes: March Madness is a peak FanDuel moment — but college-context rules and state college-contest exclusions apply to creative.

owners.name: Warner Bros. Discovery
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sportsbook in legal states; Bleacher Report has run sportsbook content partnerships. NBA rights loss reshapes its sports shelf from 2025-26.
owners.fanduel_notes: B/R house of sports social reach is strong for younger bettors; verify current sports portfolio before planning.

owners.name: Amazon
owners.stance_notes: TNF has carried sportsbook sponsorship/alt-cast integrations (DraftKings association on betting streams). Amazon Ads gambling policy is restrictive-by-approval; Twitch policy limits gambling content.
owners.fanduel_notes: TNF + NBA make Amazon a must-evaluate; note existing competitor integration on TNF betting alt-casts — verify current deal status.

owners.name: Netflix
owners.stance_notes: Ad tier has excluded gambling as a category since launch (with political/tobacco). Live sports experiments may pressure this — verify current policy.
owners.fanduel_notes: Currently not buyable for sportsbook; watchlist — if policy opens for live sport, early-mover advantage.

owners.name: Hulu (Disney)
owners.stance_notes: Historically restrictive on gambling; later policy softening extended betting ads into more Disney inventory with state targeting and approvals. Verify current category rules.
owners.fanduel_notes: State-targeted CTV vehicle when approved; retain a current partnership conflict check across Disney inventory.

owners.name: Roku
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sports-betting ads with state-level targeting and licensing documentation; platform-level age screens.
owners.fanduel_notes: Useful for state-precise CTV reach and app-install placements on the platform UI.

owners.name: YouTube / Google
owners.stance_notes: Google Ads gambling policy: certification required, state-by-state eligibility, 18+/21+ targeting rules; Sunday Ticket adds premium NFL inventory.
owners.fanduel_notes: Core certified channel for both search and video; state targeting is native to the toolset.

owners.name: Meta
owners.stance_notes: Written permission per advertiser, licensed-state targeting, 21+ audience restriction; creative rules on responsible gambling.
owners.fanduel_notes: Approved-advertiser path is established for major sportsbooks; key DR/app channel.

owners.name: TikTok
owners.stance_notes: Real-money gambling ads broadly prohibited; limited market-by-market exceptions/pilots have existed for licensed operators — verify current US position.
owners.fanduel_notes: Treat as organic/creator channel first; paid path uncertain — verification task before any plan line.

owners.name: X (Twitter)
owners.stance_notes: Allows gambling ads from licensed operators with state targeting; policy enforcement environment has shifted repeatedly — verify current rules and brand-safety posture.
owners.fanduel_notes: Live-sport conversation reach; weigh brand-safety review alongside category rules.

owners.name: Snap
owners.stance_notes: Gambling ads allowed with prior approval, licensed states, age targeting.
owners.fanduel_notes: Young-skewing reach for pick'em/DFS-adjacent products where eligible; note young-audience sensitivity in responsible-gambling framing.

owners.name: Reddit
owners.stance_notes: Allows licensed gambling advertisers with restrictions and state targeting.
owners.fanduel_notes: Doubles as the perception-research source (workstream D); community context needs careful creative.

owners.name: Nexstar
owners.stance_notes: Local stations accept sportsbook ads in legal states; strong local news adjacency; state footprint maps cleanly to eligibility.
owners.fanduel_notes: Local TV is the state-targeting workhorse — launch-state playbooks (e.g. NC-style launches) lean on it.

owners.name: Sinclair
owners.stance_notes: Accepts in legal states; historical Bally Sports RSN entanglement (rebranded/restructured) shows category's local-sports depth.
owners.fanduel_notes: Local reach + sports adjacency; verify current RSN landscape before planning regional sports inventory.

owners.name: Gray Media
properties: Local stations, strong in mid/small markets
owners.stance_notes: Accepts in legal states.
owners.fanduel_notes: Complements Nexstar for full state coverage in launch plans.

owners.name: TEGNA
owners.stance_notes: Accepts in legal states.
owners.fanduel_notes: Large-market local coverage for mature-state defence.

owners.name: Yahoo Sports
owners.stance_notes: Accepts sportsbook advertising; has run operator partnerships (BetMGM was its integrated sportsbook partner).
owners.fanduel_notes: COMPETITOR ADJACENCY: fantasy audience overlap is high-value; verify current partner exclusivities.

owners.name: The Athletic (NYT)
owners.stance_notes: Carries betting content/partnerships (has had BetMGM odds partnership); NYT core news inventory excludes gambling.
owners.fanduel_notes: Premium sports-reader audience; content-partnership route as much as display.

owners.name: Bleacher Report (WBD)
owners.stance_notes: Young sports audience; has operated sportsbook content deals.
owners.fanduel_notes: Social-native sports reach for 21-34; strong for parlay-culture creative where compliant.

owners.name: Sportradar / Genius Sports
owners.stance_notes: Official-data ad products built specifically for sportsbook acquisition (odds-reactive creative).
owners.fanduel_notes: Channel-delivery intelligence angle: odds-synced dynamic creative at state level.

owners.name: The Trade Desk
owners.stance_notes: Supports licensed gambling advertisers subject to publisher-level category permissions and state targeting.
owners.fanduel_notes: Named future connector in the platform Reporting tab — programmatic CTV/display execution layer.

owners.name: iHeartMedia
owners.stance_notes: Accepts in legal states; sports podcasts carry heavy sportsbook load.
owners.fanduel_notes: Drive-time + sports podcasts for state launches; host-read compliance scripts required.

owners.name: SiriusXM
owners.stance_notes: Accepts in legal states; national feed makes state-targeting harder on satellite — streaming side targets better.
owners.fanduel_notes: National sports-talk reach; use streaming inventory for state precision.

owners.name: Spotify
owners.stance_notes: Restrictive gambling policy by market with approvals; The Ringer sports podcasts have carried operator ads — verify current US rules.
owners.fanduel_notes: The Ringer audience is a bullseye; policy verification first.

owners.name: DAZN
owners.stance_notes: Betting-friendly platform; operates its own betting brand in some markets (conflict check by market).
owners.fanduel_notes: Combat-sports audience; niche but bettor-dense.

owners.name: Barstool Sports
owners.stance_notes: Post-PENN independence, open to operator partnerships again; brand-safety and compliance-history review essential.
owners.fanduel_notes: Bettor-dense audience with real brand-risk trade-offs — a deliberate decision, not a default line.
